item.title: Barzan Unveils Drones and USVs at Milipol Amid Gulf Tensions
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
At Milipol 2026, Qatar's Barzan Holdings unveiled a new suite of FPV drones, USVs, and a strategic air defense partnership with Ukraine's Carmine Sky to fortify critical infrastructure against escalating regional threats.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The showcase features the Rasid USV surveillance watercraft and the dual-capable Barzan Conversion Solution coast guard vessel. [SPLIT] ⚡ Doha's defense acceleration is driven by mounting regional vulnerabilities, including Iranian strikes and a September 2025 Israeli raid. item.title: HD Hyundai and Kiewit Partner for US Shipyard Push
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
South Korea's HD Hyundai and North American firm Kiewit are teaming up to build a high-tech US shipyard by 2029, targeting Navy auxiliary vessels and advanced industrial automation.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The joint venture directly addresses critical shortfalls in the US maritime industrial base by targeting both US Navy auxiliary vessels and commercial hulls. [SPLIT] ⚡ The initiative is anchored by broader bilateral trade frameworks, including a massive $350 billion South Korean investment pledge that earmarks $150 billion for US shipbuilding.
